description: This is an Angular component file (TypeScript) defining the UserComponent, responsible for the user management UI. It includes logic for loading, searching, paginating, and managing user data, as well as opening modals for adding and editing users. The component depends on Angular core modules, PrimeNG UI components, and RxJS for reactive event handling.

classes.name: UserComponent
classes.description: An Angular standalone component for managing users. It provides functionalities such as listing users, searching, pagination, and managing modals for adding and editing users. It interacts with the UI via PrimeNG components and handles internal state for user list and UI modals.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up search debouncing, and loads the initial user list.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and completes observables to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: handleTenantChange
methods.description: Handles tenant change events to reset pagination and reload users.

methods.name: loadUsers
methods.description: Loads the user list, applying search filter and pagination. Uses a static list as placeholder.

methods.name: onPageChange
methods.description: Handles pagination page change events and reloads user data accordingly.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Triggers the search subject for debounced search.

methods.name: addNewUser
methods.description: Opens the modal/drawer to add a new user.

methods.name: onAddUserModalClose
methods.description: Handles closing of the add user modal.

methods.name: onUserAdded
methods.description: Handles the event when a user is added, shows success message, and reloads the list.

methods.name: editUser
methods.description: Opens the edit user drawer with the selected user.

methods.name: onEditUserModalClose
methods.description: Handles closing of the edit user drawer.

methods.name: onUserUpdated
methods.description: Handles the event when a user is updated, shows success message, and reloads the list.

methods.name: isLoggedInOrRootUser
methods.description: Checks if the provided user is the currently logged-in user or the root user, based on stored user data.
